why_best: A sustained, focused posture gives the viewer ample time to appreciate the intricate digital drafting process without distracting camera motion.
why_bad: Hyperactive cuts or rapid camera sweeps would undermine the calm, meticulous technical clarity required for a broadcast news graphic.
trap: A near-miss would allow the focal UI accents to blur into the background dark canvas instead of cleanly directing the audience's eye to the active node points.
